summary: Tested email verification gating for gamification features. Code review confirms correct implementation of EmailVerificationGate component wrapping gated features. Found critical bug: registration endpoint doesn't create session, causing immediate auth failures for new users.

critical.issue: Registration creates JWT token with session_id but doesn't create session record in DB. This causes 'Session expired or invalid' error on any authenticated request after registration.
critical.root_cause: create_token() generates session_id but create_session() is not called. Login flow at line 273-276 correctly creates session before token.

integration_issues.issue: After login from homepage, navigating to /rewards shows 'Sign In to Continue'. Auth state appears lost on route navigation.

notes: Properly checks user.email_verified before showing children
Shows blurred overlay with 'Verify Email to Unlock' for unverified users
Has 'Verify Now' button that opens verification modal
Modal supports sending code and verifying email

backend_verification_endpoints.send_email_verification: Correctly generates 6-digit code, stores with expiry, sends email
backend_verification_endpoints.verify_email: Correctly validates code, updates email_verified, awards 5 coins

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix /api/auth/register to create session before creating token (add create_session call similar to login flow)
Investigate auth state persistence issue when navigating to /rewards page
critical_code_review_comments: Registration endpoint at /app/backend/routes/auth.py line 202 calls create_token(user_id) without creating a session first. This needs to match the login flow pattern at lines 273-276.
Suggested fix: Add 'session = await create_session(user_id, request, geo_data)' before line 202, then use 'token = create_token(user_id, session['id'])'
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test users: test_unverified_user@example.com, test_verify_*@example.com
context_for_next_testing_agent: Registration auth bug must be fixed first before testing email verification flow. After fix, test: 1) Create new user via registration, 2) Navigate to /rewards, 3) Verify ungated features are clickable, 4) Verify gated features show 'Verify Email to Unlock' overlay, 5) Click 'Verify Now' and complete verification flow.

rca_of_issue.issue: Session expired or invalid error after registration
rca_of_issue.root_cause: JWT token created during registration contains a session_id (auto-generated in create_token function), but no corresponding session record exists in the sessions collection. When get_current_user validates the token, it finds session_id in payload and tries to lookup the session, which fails.
reproduction_steps: Use returned token to call GET /api/auth/me
Error: 'Session expired or invalid. Please log in again.'
rca_of_issue.fix: Add session creation in register endpoint before creating token, similar to login flow
